headlines.title: 美财长贝森特称 霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性
headlines.summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特日前在接受美国亚利桑那州地方电视台采访时说，随着地缘政治局势变化，今后越来越多能源运输将绕过霍尔木兹海峡。他认为，霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性。鉴于伊朗试图控制这条咽喉要道，海峡将无法回到过去的状态。在接下来两年时间里，海峡将变成一片普通水域，逐步变得不再那么重要。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent says Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose strategic importance
headlines.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a recent interview with an Arizona local TV station that as geopolitical conditions shift, an increasing amount of energy shipping will bypass the Strait of Hormuz in the future. He believes the strait will gradually lose its strategic importance. Given Iran's attempts to control this critical waterway, the strait will not return to its previous state. Over the next two years, it will become an ordinary body of water and gradually diminish in importance. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: Commercial conversion accelerating! Over half of residential land parcels transacted in Shanghai and Shenzhen came via 'identity switches'
headlines.summary_en: [Accelerated commercial-to-residential conversion! More than half of transacted residential land parcels in Shanghai and Shenzhen were 'converted in status'] As vacancy rates for commercial office buildings climb while homes in core areas remain hard to come by, and as new construction land faces the constraint that it is 'in principle not used for commercial real estate development,' and as local governments face land finance pressure — how to find increments within existing stock? Since 2026, core cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Beijing have given the same answer — land use re-zoning. Plots once designated for office buildings and factories are now being converted into residential land and entering the land market.

headlines.title_en: On August 7, Shanghai Export Container Comprehensive Freight Index stood at 3276.14 points, up 2.2% from the previous period
headlines.summary_en: On August 7, the Shanghai Export Containerized Freight Index released by the Shanghai Shipping Exchange Research Institute (in preparation) stood at 3276.14 points, up 2.2% from the previous period. According to the latest data from the General Administration of Customs, China's July exports rose 23.9% year-on-year in USD terms, maintaining a high growth rate. The strong export performance provides long-term support for the stable development of China's export container shipping market.

headlines.title: 7月我国线下消费持续升温 消费支付金额同比增长2.2%
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委国家信息中心最新发布的先行指标显示，7月，我国线下消费持续升温，带动商品消费和服务消费协同向好。7月消费支付金额同比增长2.2%，增速较上月加快0.8个百分点。中小商户的经营活力稳步增强，反映中小商户经营状况的实体商业活力指数较上月提高3.1%。实体商户经营健康指数、线下消费者活力指数环比均有增长。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: July offline consumption continued to heat up, with consumer payment amounts up 2.2% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Leading indicators released by the State Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission show that in July, China's offline consumption continued to heat up, driving coordinated improvement in both goods and services consumption. July consumption payment amounts rose 2.2% year-on-year, accelerating by 0.8 percentage points from the previous month. The operating vitality of small and medium-sized merchants steadily strengthened, with the physical commerce vitality index reflecting SME operating conditions rising 3.1% from the previous month. The physical merchant business health index and offline consumer vitality index both rose month-on-month. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Deutsche Bank: predicts US July CPI to rise 0.15% month-on-month
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 8 – The most important data release next week will be Wednesday's U.S. July CPI report, followed by PPI data on Thursday. Deutsche Bank U.S. economists expect headline CPI to rise 0.15% month-on-month, versus a 0.42% decline in June; core CPI is expected to rise 0.26% month-on-month, unchanged from June. For PPI, headline PPI is expected to rise 0.22% month-on-month (previously 0.13%).

headlines.title: 香港保监局：密切关注内地有关金融产品税务安排
headlines.summary: 近期报道称中国内地税务居民购买香港保险的收益被纳入征税范围。对此，香港保险监管局回应称，政府和保监局正密切注意内地有关金融产品税务安排的最新发展，同时会与业界保持紧密沟通。中国居民就境外投资收益必须依法申报及缴税的要求一直存在，市场不用过度解读或作出揣测。香港保险市场发展成熟，产品设计灵活先进，可提供货币选择、环球资产配置、人生规划、财富传承等专业服务，相信对内地客户有一定吸引力。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Insurance Authority: closely monitoring tax arrangements for mainland financial products
headlines.summary_en: Recent reports suggest that income from Hong Kong insurance policies purchased by mainland Chinese tax residents has been included in the scope of taxation. In response, the Hong Kong Insurance Authority stated that the government and the IA are closely monitoring the latest developments in the mainland's tax arrangements for financial products and maintaining close communication with the industry. The requirement for Chinese residents to declare and pay tax on overseas investment income has always existed, and the market should not over-interpret or speculate. The Hong Kong insurance market is mature, with flexible and advanced product designs offering currency options, global asset allocation, life planning, wealth succession, and other professional services, which should hold appeal for mainland clients.

headlines.title: 禁止“抱团”抬价！东北明确新能源集中报价仅限同省同集团
headlines.summary: 据中国电力报，国家能源局东北监管局日前印发《东北区域集中式新能源发电企业集中报价工作实施方案（试行）》，对辽宁、吉林、黑龙江三省集中式风电、光伏发电企业的市场报价行为作出系统性规范。其中明确，原则上仅允许同一集团（同一母公司、同一控股股东、同一实际控制人等）内同一省的新能源发电企业进行集中报价，禁止跨集团、跨省集中报价。禁止具有竞争关系的经营者达成固定或变更商品关系的垄断协议。

headlines.title_en: Ban on 'group' price hikes! Northeast clearly limits new energy centralized quotes to same province and same group
headlines.summary_en: According to China Electric Power News, the Northeast Energy Regulatory Bureau of the National Energy Administration recently issued the 'Implementation Plan for Centralized Quotation by Centralized New Energy Generation Enterprises in the Northeast Region (Trial),' systematically regulating market quotation behavior by centralized wind and solar power generation enterprises in Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang provinces. It stipulates that, in principle, only new energy generation enterprises within the same province and under the same group (same parent company, same controlling shareholder, or same actual controller) are permitted to conduct centralized quotations, and cross-group or cross-province centralized quotations are prohibited. Competing business operators are also prohibited from reaching monopoly agreements that fix or change commodity prices.

headlines.title: 7月我国主要港口货船离港载重量同比增长56.4%
headlines.summary: 今年以来，国家持续推动外贸“稳规模优结构”成效明显，外贸韧性持续增强。港口是外贸的晴雨表。7月，我国主要港口货运船舶离港载重量同比增长56.4%，增速比6月大幅提高38.9个百分点。

headlines.title_en: In July, cargo ship departures from major Chinese ports saw a year-on-year increase of 56.4% in loaded tonnage
headlines.summary_en: This year, the country's continuous efforts to stabilize the scale and optimize the structure of foreign trade have shown notable results, with foreign trade resilience steadily strengthening. Ports are a barometer of foreign trade. In July, the departure load capacity of cargo ships at China's major ports rose 56.4% year-on-year, with the growth rate up 38.9 percentage points from June.
